beforeAnyInspection.en: Confirm the exact work and location.
Confirm current approved drawings/specifications and applicable submittals.
Know the acceptance criteria and tolerances.
Check ITP/PIE/PRIE points, notifications and prerequisites.
Have suitable measuring/test tools and required forms.

whenYouFindAProblem.en: Do not jump immediately to an NCR: first verify the requirement and project classification rules.
Record the actual condition objectively and precisely.
Use the approved communication and escalation path.
Do not design the fix unless that authority is part of your role.
Verify the completed correction/disposition before closure.

question.en: What did I actually see or measure?
What happens next and by when?
Who verified it, when, and against what basis?

importantLimitations.en: This guide provides generic field reminders. Contract documents, codes, approved project procedures, owner requirements, delegated authority and the project quality plan govern.
Terminology such as deficiency, NCR, observation, punch item, repair, rework, concession, hold point and witness point may be defined differently by different projects.
Where safety, structural integrity, life-safety systems or engineering acceptance is implicated, follow the project's escalation and professional-responsibility requirements.
